title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-08-18
taper: From the Collection of Jeff Knudsen

ai_review.summary: Top‑curated tape delivering the historic first live Ripple and Truckin' with excellent audio quality.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers hail this as the premier version of the show on the Archive, noting its superior curation and clear sound. The performance is celebrated for featuring the very first live renditions of "Ripple" and "Truckin'", captured before a great crowd that adds to the magic. Overall the recording offers an enjoyable listening experience with historic musical moments.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the musical significance and the high‑quality curation of the tape, indicating an outstanding show and excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Curated from multiple archive sources; reviewers call it the best version available, implying clear, balanced sound with minimal issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Classic two‑set structure (acoustic opening followed by electric set) highlighted by the historic first live performances of Ripple and Truckin', creating a strong, joyful concert flow.
